post.description:
Sign a document without creating a workflow. Supports two signature appearance modes:

**Server-Side Generation Mode**: Provide `appearanceId` to use a pre-configured template from Account Management.

**Direct Image Mode**: Provide `signatureImage` (Base64) for custom signature appearance.

**Hybrid Mode**: Provide both `appearanceId` (template) and `signatureImage` (custom overlay).

**Positioning**: Specify signature location via `pageNumber`, `x`, `y`, `width`, `height` or `fieldId`.

**Metadata**: Optionally include `location`, `reason`, `contactInfo` in the signature.

Returns signed document with `documentId` and Base64-encoded content.

400.description: Invalid input - Missing appearanceId or signatureImage, or invalid positioning

get.description: Get complete audit trail for a workflow

Paginated list of workflows visible to the authenticated user (OWNER/SIGNER/WITNESS/GATEKEEPER).

Supports:
- Free-text search across selected fields via searchValue + searchFields.
- Filters via filterFields + filterValues (workflowStatus IN, workflowCategory, createdAt range).
- Pagination and sorting (createdAt/updatedAt only, default createdAt,DESC).

parameters.name: searchValue
parameters.description: Search value to apply across selected fields (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: searchFields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to search in. Allowed values: workflowName, workflowDescription, organizationId, purpose, workflowType

parameters.name: filterFields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of filter field names. Allowed values: workflowStatus, workflowCategory, createdAtFrom, createdAtTo

parameters.name: filterValues
parameters.description:
Semicolon-separated list of filter values matching filterFields by index.
Use semicolon (;) to separate values for different fields, comma (,) for multiple values within a field.
- workflowStatus: comma-separated enum values (e.g. READY,RUNNING)
- workflowCategory: enum value (e.g. B2B or B2C)
- createdAtFrom / createdAtTo: ISO-8601 timestamps
Example: READY,RUNNING;B2B;2025-01-01T00:00:00Z;2025-12-31T23:59:59Z

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field and direction. Allowed properties: createdAt (maps to workflow start date), updatedAt. Format: field,direction. Example: createdAt,desc

fromTemplate.description: Whether this workflow is created from a template

userId.description: User ID (resolved from email by the service layer)

signatureReason.description: Reason for signing (displayed in the signature)

requiredToSign.description: Whether this participant is required to complete the signing step

requireOtp.description: Whether OTP verification is required for this participant

fields.description: Unified field list for this participant. Supports SIGNATURE, INITIALS, and generic text-based fields (TEXT, EMAIL, DATE, NUMBER). Text-based fields support font, fontSize, fontColor, and textWrapping styling properties.

ParticipantRequest.description: Participant definition within a step. Each participant can have multiple fields (SIGNATURE, INITIALS, TEXT, etc.) with styling.

StepRequest.description: Step definition for workflow initialization. Defines step type, execution order, and participants.

description.description: Human-readable label displayed to the signer

value.description: Value provided by the signer at signing time

pageNumber.description: Page number where the field is placed (1-indexed)

xpos.description: X coordinate (horizontal position from left edge)

ypos.description: Y coordinate (vertical position from top edge)

scaleWidth.description: Width of the field box in points

scaleHeight.description: Height of the field box in points

primary.description: If true, this is the primary SIGNATURE field used for digital signing. Only one SIGNATURE field per participant can be primary.

fieldId.description: PDF form field ID. Read-only in responses; generated at workflow start or pre-assigned by template.

font.description: Font family for text rendering. Only applies to text-based fields. Defaults to HELVETICA.

fontSize.description: Font size in points (6-72). If null, text is auto-fitted to the field box using the textWrapping strategy. Only applies to text-based fields.

fontColor.description: Font color as hex (#RRGGBB). Defaults to #000000 (black). Only applies to text-based fields.

textWrapping.description: Text wrapping strategy. FILL_BOX scales to fill without wrapping; FILL_BOX_AND_LINEBREAK scales with line breaks; FONT_BASED uses the given fontSize. Defaults to FILL_BOX_AND_LINEBREAK if no fontSize set, FONT_BASED if fontSize is set.

UserFieldDto.description: Represents a field assigned to a workflow participant. Fields can be SIGNATURE, INITIALS, or generic text-based types (TEXT, EMAIL, DATE, NUMBER, CHECKBOX, RADIO).

image.description: Per-field base64 image. Overrides the shared flat image for this specific field. Applicable to SIGNATURE and INITIALS field types.

appearanceId.description: Per-field appearance ID for server-side generation. Applicable to SIGNATURE fields only. Overrides the shared flat appearanceId.

font.description: Font family override at sign-time (TEXT, EMAIL, DATE, NUMBER only).

fontSize.description: Font size override in points at sign-time.

fontColor.description: Font color as hex at sign-time.

textWrapping.description: Text wrapping strategy override at sign-time.

SignFieldEntry.description: Per-field entry for sign-time data. Used for SIGNATURE, INITIALS, and generic text fields (TEXT, EMAIL, DATE, NUMBER). Processing depends on the stored field type: SIGNATURE fields use image/appearanceId, INITIALS fields use image, generic fields use value and optional styling overrides.

initialsImage.description: Shared base64 initials image. Used for any INITIALS field that does not have a per-field image in the fields list. Optional if every field has its own image.

fields.description: Per-field sign-time data. Each entry references a fieldId and can carry a per-field image override. Only INITIALS fields are processed; fields not listed fall back to the shared initialsImage.

signatureImage.description: Shared base64 signature image. Used for any SIGNATURE field that does not have a per-field image in the fields list.

appearanceId.description: Shared appearance ID for server-side generation. Falls back when a SIGNATURE field does not specify its own appearanceId.

contactInfo.description: Contact information embedded in the signature

fields.description: Per-field sign-time data. Each entry references a fieldId and can carry per-field image/appearanceId (SIGNATURE), image (INITIALS), or value + styling (generic text fields). Fields not listed fall back to the shared flat values above.

appearanceId.description: Shared appearance ID for server-side generation. Falls back when a SIGNATURE field does not specify its own appearanceId.

signatureImage.description: Shared base64 signature image. Used for any SIGNATURE field that does not have a per-field image in the fields list.

certificateThumbprint.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 or SHA-1 certificate thumbprint

contactInfo.description: Contact information embedded in the signature

fields.description: Per-field sign-time data. Each entry references a fieldId and can carry per-field image/appearanceId (SIGNATURE fields). Fields not listed fall back to the shared values above.

sessionId.description: Session ID from the prepare step

signatureValue.description: Base64 raw signature value from the local signing operation

appearanceId.description: Shared appearance ID for server-side generation

fields.description: Per-field sign-time data. Each entry references a fieldId and can carry value + styling overrides (generic text fields). Fields not listed use their stored default values.

appearanceId.description: Template ID from Account Management for server-side signature generation. Use this for pre-configured templates.

signatureImage.description: Base64-encoded signature image data for direct mode. Required if appearanceId is not provided.

pageNumber.description: Page number where signature should appear (1-indexed)

fieldId.description: Signature field ID for form-based positioning

additionalProperties.description:
Optional metadata key-value pairs for signature appearance and passthrough to signing server.

Standard keys:
- signatureLocation: Physical location where document was signed (e.g., "New York, USA")
- signatureReason: Reason for signing (e.g., "Approved for release")
- contactInfo: Contact information of the signer (e.g., "john.doe@company.com")
- appearanceId: Override DTO-level appearanceId if needed

requestMetadata.description:
Optional metadata key-value pairs for signature appearance and passthrough to signing server.

Standard keys:
- signatureLocation: Physical location where document was signed (e.g., "New York, USA")
- signatureReason: Reason for signing (e.g., "Approved for release")
- contactInfo: Contact information of the signer (e.g., "john.doe@company.com")
- appearanceId: Override DTO-level appearanceId if needed

InstantSignDto.description:
Instant sign configuration with flattened structure:
- appearanceId: Template ID from Account Management (for server-side generation)
- signatureImage: Base64-encoded signature image (for direct mode)
- Positioning: pageNumber, x, y, width, height, fieldId
- requestMetadata: Map for signature metadata (signatureLocation, signatureReason, contactInfo) and custom fields
- Security: password, credentialID
- signType: SIMPLE, ADVANCED, or QUALIFIED
